name: hbm_su_quarter_r24p_nrd_mmcg_4d90ba1cc-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): hbm_su_quarter_r24p_nrd_mmcg_4d90ba1cc re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: hfd_su quarter on the r24p pin plan (hub face buses 4 tracks a bit in a 1,200 um window; r24 HC GRT overflow 33,722 at its E-face pin cluster), r24 multi-ck, mm route hold (HM 50). Generator proposal for hbm-die; GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 (r23 SU quarter GP 15k+ iterations in routability mode, r24 GP 9.3 h) | requeued: exported OT_MM_FF_SDC + setup-triage CTS fix hooks (cg_pushdown, clk_net_protect)

bench.name: quarter_pos
bench.cmd: VARIANT=r24p bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/su/bench.sh su {RUN}/bench; grep -q 'pos_rc=0' {RUN}/bench/result.txt && grep -q 'mismatches=0' {RUN}/bench/result.txt && echo QUARTER_POS_PASS

calibrate.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc' OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24 --route-mode route > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_route.sdc && python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24 --route-mode signoff > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc && { echo 'if {[llength [get_libs -quiet *_FF_*]]} {'; python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py ff hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24; echo '}'; } > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc && VARIANT=r24p CKP="ck*" SRC="{SRC}" OUT="{RUN}/routes" PD="0.45" CORES="16" NEED="120" CP="0.770" FCP="1" FCF="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/su/rtl/face_stages.tcl" SDCA="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_route.sdc" POSTSDC="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc" bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/su/route_quarter.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} su --orfs-var GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 --orfs-var ENABLE_DPO=0 --orfs-var CELL_PAD_IN_SITES_DETAIL_PLACEMENT=0 $CL_STOP_AFTER

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc' OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24 --route-mode route > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_route.sdc && python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24 --route-mode signoff > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc && { echo 'if {[llength [get_libs -quiet *_FF_*]]} {'; python3 tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py ff hfd_su --sheets results/rtl/budgets_20261006/sheets_r24; echo '}'; } > physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc && VARIANT=r24p CKP="ck*" SRC="{SRC}" OUT="{RUN}/routes" PD="0.45" CORES="16" NEED="120" CP="0.770" FCP="1" FCF="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/su/rtl/face_stages.tcl" SDCA="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_route.sdc" POSTSDC="physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_signoff.sdc physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/budget_ff_guarded.sdc" bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/su/route_quarter.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} su --orfs-var GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 --orfs-var ENABLE_DPO=0 --orfs-var CELL_PAD_IN_SITES_DETAIL_PLACEMENT=0 $CL_STOP_AFTER
